summary: TNL Mediagene filed a Form 6-K disclosing that the Nasdaq Hearings Panel granted continued listing on The Nasdaq Capital Market under conditions. The company must demonstrate compliance with the Bid Price Rule (minimum bid price) by September 21, 2026, and the Equity Rule (stockholders' equity) by October 30, 2026. The hearing occurred on August 4, 2026, after a June 22, 2026 delisting determination. Failure to meet conditions will result in delisting. Shares trade under TNMG during the exception period. No deal terms or advisors are mentioned. Watch for compliance updates on the specified deadlines.
